ipeds.title: IPEDS College Navigator - University of North Texas

stats.notes: CDS C1 totals (men 19,128 + women 22,122 applicants; 29,242 admitted; 6,388 enrolled). The C2 residency table sums to 41,247 applicants (in-state 36,749 / out-of-state 2,245 / international 2,253); admits and enrolled agree. International first-year admit rate is 40.7% (917 of 2,253) versus 72.9% in-state; the CDS does not say why. UNT left high school GPA (C11/C12) blank, so GPA fields are omitted. Undergraduate enrollment 34,414 is CDS B2 total undergraduates (degree-seeking nonresidents: 1,546). The CDS file prints year digits incompletely, so the 2025-2026 label comes from the file name. Student-faculty ratio 25:1 is from IPEDS College Navigator.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A: SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'.

cost.notes: CDS G1 first-year full-year amounts (nonresident tuition equals out-of-state $20,823; per credit hour $685 nonresident vs $280 in-state). The CDS marks 2026-27 costs as not yet available, so these are most likely 2025-26 amounts. CDS H6: only institutional non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 1,075 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received it (avg $5,928). CDS C7 rows for test scores, essay and recommendations were left unmarked, so they are omitted.
